scope: Method lineage for a local positive-tree thinning extension of the independent finite-volume collision reference into the complete prescribed column.

sources.title: An Efficient Stochastic Algorithm for Studying Coagulation Dynamics and Gelation Phenomena
sources.reading_extent: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record only. The full algorithm, proofs, experiments and figures were not read.
sources.use: Published lineage for fictitious jumps and acceptance–rejection in stochastic coalescence; the specific separable majorant and positive tree are local derivations.
sources.limit: No theorem from this abstract-only reading is claimed for the snow kernel or coupled column.

retrieval_limits: A WIAS page for the related 2001 Eibeck–Wagner stochastic-particle approximation paper returned a browser cache miss; that retrieval did not supply inspected full-paper evidence.
Search results for weighted-particle methods informed method selection only. No weighted-particle convergence theorem or implementation is claimed or adopted here.
local_derivations: The snow encounter kernel is bounded by 2 C (D_i^2+D_j^2)(v_i+v_j). Factoring its ordered pair sum yields the two positive mixture components used to propose unordered pairs, including rejected self-pairs.
Thinning with K/Kbar preserves the unordered finite-volume collision rate K/V at fixed masses and layer properties.
Positive sum-tree parent recomputation avoids accumulated subtractive rate-sum drift; it does not remove ordinary floating-point summation error.

Whole-fragment allocation plus a retained remainder preserves expected chip mass and number. Remainder mass is bounded by one prescribed fragment per layer; delayed participation remains an approximation requiring volume controls.
Independent exponential downward layer transitions generate the frozen upwind settling equation in expectation.
The positive Heun growth stages share the prescribed vapour supply and preserve a water source ledger. Split-time and sampling errors require independent controls.
external_bytes: No external datasets or full-paper bytes were added. The source-bound direct-event reference already belongs to this repository.
evidence_state: Implemented numerical method with separate closed-box and full-column controls; physical geometry, breakup and moist exposure retain their existing evidence limits.
